description:
Homes currently advertised for sale in an area of England or Wales, by criteria:
"find me a 3-bed under £400k in BS7", "flats over 60 m2 in Wimbledon". Filter by
asking price, bedrooms, property type and floor area; and, for adverts GetMovely has
matched to an exact address, by freehold or leasehold, energy rating and whether the
owner lives there. Each row has the asking price, bedrooms, type, floor area, price
per square metre, when it was listed and days on the market, the portal, agent and
link to the advert, and for a matched home its address key, response likelihood and
the link that opens a letter to its owner. 20 a page; `total` is every advert that
fits. Adverts are re-read regularly, so a brand-new listing can be missing.

area.description: Where to look: a postcode district ('BS7'), a full postcode ('SW19 1AB'), a town ('Wimbledon'), a street with its district or town ('Elm Road, BS7'), or a whole city, council or region ('Leeds', 'Camden', 'London').
area.title: Area

epc_ratings.description: Energy ratings to keep, for example ['A','B','C']. Only adverts matched to an exact address.
epc_ratings.title: Epc Ratings

min_floor_area_m2.description: Smallest floor area in square metres. Adverts with no floor area on record are left out.
min_floor_area_m2.title: Min Floor Area M2

owner_occupied.description: True: only homes whose Energy Performance Certificate records them as owner-occupied (response likelihood High). Only adverts matched to an exact address.
owner_occupied.title: Owner Occupied

property_type.description: From the advert's own words. 'house' is any house including bungalows; 'flat' includes apartments and maisonettes; 'terraced' includes end of terrace.
property_type.title: Property Type

sort.description: 'newest' advert first (default), by asking price, by asking price per square metre (lowest first), or largest first.
sort.title: Sort

tenure.description: As recorded at the home's last sale. Only adverts matched to an exact address can be filtered this way.
tenure.title: Tenure
